name: minimind
description: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
one_liner: A compact, from-scratch recipe and codebase that lets anyone train their own small AI language model in about two hours, without needing a data center.
buyer: An AI bootcamp or corporate training provider teaching engineers how large language models actually work under the hood.
business_use_cases: A coding bootcamp builds a paid 'train your own LLM in a weekend' workshop around it.
A GPU/hardware vendor demos it on their own chips to show enterprise buyers low-cost AI training performance.
A course creator records a paid tutorial series walking viewers through the repo step by step.

money_ideas.idea: Paid cohort-based workshop teaching people to train their own small LLM
A recorded video course sold once per buyer

steal_this: Record yourself running the full training end to end and sell it as a cheap mini-course this weekend.
